facts: KX758647.1 is a complete 7086 bp circular source record named pGrDL_SP.
The source-forward interval 571..4649 is 4079 bp and contains two contiguous transcription-unit spans.
The selected region excludes the source record's T-DNA borders, bacterial replication background, and nptI selectable marker.
deterministic_derivations: The product sequence is source_record[570:4649] in source-forward coordinate order.
TU1 is reconstructed from three reverse-complemented UI inputs followed by one whole-unit reverse orientation operation.
TU2 is reconstructed by concatenating the three source-forward UI inputs.
Five source-unannotated intervals are retained byte-for-byte inside the six composite UI input spans.
inferences: The six composite spans are the lossless inputs for the current generic Multi-TU model; they are not claims that every base has one regulatory identity.
unknowns: The biological functions of the five source-unannotated intervals are not established by the source record.
Offline redistribution rights beyond accession-based reproducible extraction are not established by this contract.
Experimental performance equivalence is not assessed.
formal_limitations: MT-01 reproduces only a deterministic two-TU region from the public complete construct.
MT-01 does not reproduce the complete pGrDL_SP vector or claim to generate the complete circular KX758647.1 plasmid.
The result contains no vector background, backbone, origin, T-DNA border, or selectable marker.
The contract does not establish expression success, experimental validation, or wet-lab readiness.
